stories.headline: Three world records for a weightlifter in Nagoya
stories.summary: Ri Song-gum of North Korea won the women's 49kg weightlifting gold at the 2026 Asian Games. She set three world records on the way: 94kg in the snatch, 121kg in the clean and jerk, and 215kg overall. The event was held at the Nagoya City Trade and Industry Centre.

stories.headline: A field goal kicked high in the Swiss Alps
stories.summary: Adam Vinatieri has a Guinness World Records title for the highest field goal ever kicked. He made it in the Swiss Alps at an altitude of 3,454 metres, which is 11,332 feet. He played 24 seasons in the National Football League and won four Super Bowls.

stories.headline: An amateur archaeologist finds silver Roman coins
stories.summary: An amateur archaeologist in Germany has discovered silver Roman coins dating back to the 2nd century. They have gone on display at the Rheinisches Landesmuseum Bonn. The museum is one of the oldest in the country and already holds ancient busts and figures from Roman times.

stories.headline: A penguin named for the first time in a century
stories.summary: Researchers have recognised a new gentoo penguin on the Kerguelen Islands, the first new penguin species named in more than 100 years. Genetic work showed that what was treated as one gentoo species is really four. The team read whole genomes from 64 penguins at 10 breeding colonies.
